plan_review.notes: The separate-model review found that creation retries alone cannot repair existing unassigned nodes; replaced that design with a scoped post-creation and hourly trusted intake reprocessor.

code_review.notes: Reviewed all five changed files. The marker/author concern is covered by intakeOpenedIssue trusted-opener validation; repeated intake is intentionally idempotent and preserves existing kickoff comments.

independent_grade.notes: The implementation correctly queries for managed epic nodes, extracts text blockers, and only runs intake on nodes without open blockers. Edge cases (like nodes closing mid-run or being claimed by the agent already) and transient API errors are handled properly. The diff adds solid unit test coverage for the core node extraction/intake logic, as well as test assertions for the GitHub Actions workflow configurations. The code is well-scoped, adheres to repository patterns, and includes no unrelated refactors.
